en.title: A browser game as a WeChat mini game
en.body: tools/wechat/export-wechat.mjs packages a browser game made with the engine as a WeChat mini game project, unchanged: one game.js with an adapter that makes a document, page classes, the screen canvas, touches as pointer events, files, storage, sound and the scenery under the canvas out of wx, plus game.json and project.config.json. With --playwright, WebP pictures are written again as JPEG or PNG. tools/wechat/check-minigame.mjs runs the folder in a headless browser with a stand-in for wx. A ported 2D game was played this way to its first night; WeChat itself, DevTools and phones were not run, and uploading stays with the game's owner, who holds the AppID and upload key.

zh.title: 把浏览器游戏做成微信小游戏
zh.body: tools/wechat/export-wechat.mjs 把用引擎做的浏览器游戏原样打包成微信小游戏项目：一个 game.js，内含适配器，用 wx 造出文档、网页的类、屏幕画布、作为指针事件的触摸、文件、存储、声音和画布下的场景；另有 game.json 与 project.config.json。加 --playwright 时，WebP 图片改写为 JPEG 或 PNG。tools/wechat/check-minigame.mjs 用 wx 的替身在无头浏览器里运行这个目录。一个移植的 2D 游戏这样试玩到了第一夜；微信本身、开发者工具和手机都没有运行，上传由持有 AppID 和上传密钥的游戏所有者完成。
